meta.title: Tonelli Prints — Custom 3D printing for brands · Nijmegen · Rome
meta.description: B2B 3D-printing studio in Nijmegen and Rome. NFC keychains, branded accessories, custom merchandise and employee kit for hospitality, events and retail. In PLA, PETG and carbon fibre.
meta.ogImageAlt: Tonelli Prints: we print your brand into objects people want to keep

hero.title: We print your brand into objects people want to keep.
hero.sub: Tonelli Prints is a B2B 3D-printing studio in Nijmegen and Rome. We make custom accessories, smart NFC keychains, souvenirs and employee kit, for hotels, restaurants, venues, and the brands they put on shelves.

images.alt: Yellow pasta-shaped keychains on a chopping board

logoStage.label: Interactive 3D scene: the Tonelli logo is printed layer by layer, receives an NFC tag halfway through, is sealed and shown as a finished piece

products.title: Objects with your brand on them. That people want to keep.

projects.title: A few brands we already work with.

about.title: A small team. Two studios. Three people answer the phone.
about.body: No call centres, no account-manager carousel. The three of us run Tonelli day-to-day. When you write, one of us writes back, by name.

studios.title: Two studios. One team. Same hands.

status.fallback: We reply within one working day

process.title: Four steps. Two weeks, usually less.
process.sub: We do not run on quote-form-into-the-void. Every project gets a named contact who answers within a working day.

materials.title: Six filaments. One catalogue, growing.
materials.sub: We hold the materials our clients actually order.
materials.pending: Details coming soon. In the meantime, ask us: we reply the same day.
